_doc: Round 4 paint-over (ESCALATION 2) for the drive-9 Q stamp at 144 px. Hand-placed on the R4u underlay; STALE if it changes. The head is tilted about 26 deg (from the eye landmarks), so the features are drawn stair-stepped in screen space.

layers.name: face_base
layers.why: Face critic 2: a clean face plane before the features (FC-P35); the old stamp's eyes are cleared.

layers.name: brows
layers.why: Q is the strike: brows angle down toward the centre (a set, fierce look), drawn in the mid hair tone.

layers.name: eye_far
layers.why: Face critic 2: the lash mass with an outer flick, the iris ramp and a catchlight, along the tilted eye line (far eye, outer corner left).

layers.name: eye_near
layers.why: as eye_far (near eye, outer corner right, flick up-right)

layers.name: blush
layers.why: Face critic 2: the blush, on the strike too.

layers.name: mouth
layers.why: MOVESET Q: the kiai, a small open mouth (dark with a lighter tongue step).

layers.name: strands_out
layers.why: Head and hair 4: a strand flung off the outline by the stamp.

layers.name: tabard_folds
layers.why: Materials 14 and mass: 'the refs' silhouettes are big cloth shapes; ours reads as flat white planks'; pipe folds as a lavender shadow line with a near-white lit line beside it.
